identification_strategy: One-line: RDD — treatment = Extended benefits for unemployed aged 50+, control = Unemployed just under age 50; shock/instrument/cutoff = Age 50 and regional border

key_variables.treatment: Extended unemployment benefits from 30 weeks to 209 weeks
key_variables.control: Unemployed individuals just under age 50 and those in control regions

conclusion_detail: Extended benefits increase unemployment duration by at least 0.32 weeks per additional week of benefits.
main_effect: Unemployment duration increases by at least 0.32 weeks per additional week of benefits
notes: Potential manipulation of age at entry into unemployment and regional differences in industry structure could affect results.
